questions.unnecessary_complexity: No material complexity beyond the exact-input authority boundary and deterministic package assembly. E3.7 does not recompute accepted science; it verifies and packages the accepted E3.1-E3.6 chain plus the persisted EVO2 SpeciesCatalog.
questions.duplicate_truth: No duplicate scientific owner was introduced. The accepted E3.6 temporal program remains the immediate ecology predecessor; earlier accepted stages are immutable chain inputs/evidence and the persisted EVO2 catalog remains external accepted taxonomy input.
questions.implicit_owner: No canonical G/ENV/MAT/WQ/SD/TF, species taxonomy, individual entity, persistence, transaction, network, XFER1, asset-scatter, or production authority is claimed.
questions.coupling_reduction: The compiler consumes only exact accepted artifacts through a binding manifest and raw identity verification; it does not call earlier stage compilers or ambient runtime services.
questions.sibling_surface_fix: No sibling production/runtime/owner surface required mutation. All changes remain under E3.7 research/control/test/evidence paths allowed by the Work Order.
questions.removable_code: Independent exact-input rebuild in validate_output_integrity is intentionally retained because plain/reconstructed JSON must not gain serialization authority.
questions.design_regression: No design regression found. Same accepted snapshots/catalog produce the same PlanetEcologyProgram bytes/hash in fresh processes, and all authority flags remain research-only.
questions.refactor_if_redesigned: Keep exact raw input verification, cross-stage lineage checks, verified input/output capabilities, and byte-bound committed artifact. Future E3.8 should vary accepted planet fixtures without weakening these invariants.

pre_freeze_issues_closed.issue: Initial E3.7 CI over-constrained catalog lineage by requiring E3.5 to repeat catalog_hash directly.
pre_freeze_issues_closed.resolution: The predicate was corrected to preserve accepted transitive lineage E3.4 -> persisted catalog and E3.5 -> E3.4. No accepted scientific artifact changed.

pre_freeze_issues_closed.issue: Committed generated PlanetEcologyProgram was initially absent by design.
pre_freeze_issues_closed.resolution: Exact Actions output was frozen to validation/ecology/eco-evo3-e3-7-planet-ecology-program.generated.json, then the temporary write-capability workflow was removed. Final executable freeze uses a read-only workflow and exact artifact identity predicates.

project_control_observation.note: Global/ECO/directional RED are retained as evidence and are not reinterpreted as GREEN or NON_RED. Fresh review-head Project Control evidence is required after the evidence-only commit.

remaining_risks: Fresh independent Reviewer must inspect the exact immutable review head, authority boundary, deterministic assembly, cross-stage lineage, and evidence freshness.
Independent Verifier remains mandatory after Reviewer PASS.
E3.7 remains research-only and is not accepted until role-separated review/verification and checkpoint acceptance complete.
E3.8, XFER1, and production ECO authority remain blocked/inactive.
